hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: LOAD-BEARING INFERENCE CHECK: Before responding, scan for load-bearing inferences — choices that would change the shape of the answer if wrong (goal, audience, scope, domain, constraints, definition of success). If even one is unconfirmed AND cannot be resolved from the brain or local memory, ask clarifying questions before proceeding. Trivial tasks (renames, typo fixes, known scripts) skip this check.
